title: fix(rangeInput): convert labels to templates
body:
This moves the `labels` option to the `templates`:

| Before             | After                     |
| ------------------ | ------------------------- |
| `labels`           | `templates`               |
| `labels.separator` | `templates.separatorText` |
| `labels.submit`    | `templates.submitText`    |
